description: This file defines types and functions related to managing the state of pending tool calls within a session context. It includes a type alias for pending tool call objects, a state interface with methods for manipulating and querying the state, and a factory function to create an instance of the state with internal storage implemented as a Map.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of pending tool calls.

methods.name: entries
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the pending tool calls as key-value pairs.

methods.name: getToolName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the tool associated with a given ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a pending tool call by its ID.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all pending tool calls from the state.

methods.name: trackToolCalls
methods.description: Adds multiple tool calls to the pending state.

methods.name: getPendingIds
methods.description: Returns an array of all pending tool call IDs.

methods.name: shouldFlushForSanitizedDrop
methods.description: Indicates whether to flush based on the presence of pending calls.

methods.name: shouldFlushBeforeNonToolResult
methods.description: Determines if flushing should occur before a non-tool result, based on the next role and call count.

methods.name: shouldFlushBeforeNewToolCalls
methods.description: Determines if flushing should occur before adding new tool calls.

ctags.name: PendingToolCall
ctags.pattern: /^export type PendingToolCall = { id: string; name?: string };$/

ctags.name: pending
ctags.pattern: /^  const pending = new Map<string, string | undefined>();$/
